utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—what’s the quick version of what needs fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it’s mostly a few neighborhood fixes and organizing the drop-offs for the repair drive. I’m still planning to swing by and let everyone know what’s going on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, sounds simple enough—I'll help keep it moving. Just point me to the drop-off spot and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. Let me know if you want me to send the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center should work better with the school schedule. Please send the updated details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send the updated details for Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’m still remembering tools, spare wire, and a couple of lanterns. I’ll check what I have at home and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Oren — I can help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the table while you set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that’d help a lot. I’ll look at what I’ve got at home and be back soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, we’re mainly looking for tools, spare parts, and a few extra hands to help with bikes and small appliances. If you want, I can point you to what’s needed most right now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, point me to what you need most right now—I can help with tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — we could really use a set of basic hand tools and a few bike repair parts first. If you’ve got any of that, I can tell you where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira — just come by when you can, and I’ll have something for you to fix.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll finish my errands and swing by in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Ira — I’ll be here when you get back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Leo—if you can make it, I’d love for you to come by and lend a hand at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can come by and help. I’ll head over now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Leo—thanks! I’m glad you can make it, and we’ll get started as soon as you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — is the repair drive still going on? I can help if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s still going on. We could use help with the broken fence by the community lot and the corner by the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m heading over now to help with the fence and the corner by the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? Folks are still gathering tools and a few donations, so it’s coming along. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m just hearing bits and pieces, so I appreciate the update. Let me know if you hear where it’s happening or what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — as soon as I hear where they’re setting up or what’s still needed, I’ll pass it along. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — are we getting enough donations for those urgent fixes so far?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re getting there, Mina — enough to cover the urgent fixes so far, though a little more would help. I’m heading to patch the cracks and level the loose edge by the gate now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — please keep me posted if the gap widens or you need anything else for the gate.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana. I’ll bring my gloves and stop by once everything’s set, so I can help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks, Eli. I’m just waiting on the repair details and meeting spot before I share anything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Hana. I’ll wait for the details and keep my gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. I’ll keep an eye out for tools too, and maybe a lantern if I can find one.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Rey. I’ll keep track of the tools and lanterns, and thanks for helping out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Glad to help. I’ll see what I can find and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive location now—it’s at the community center parking lot by the blue tent.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, so the location is set at the community center parking lot by the blue tent—what time is it starting?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the start time yet, but I’ll check and let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is coming up—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive and let everyone know what’s going on. I’ll check what they still need and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. Let me know what they’re still short on, and I’ll help with the urgent stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the quick version again: a few cracks, a loose edge by the gate, and it mainly needs patching and a quick leveling.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help patch the cracks and level the edge by the gate. Where should I start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Start with the cracks near the gate, then the loose edge if you can. Keep it quick and simple.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking — the repair drive is still on, right? Have we got the date and drop-off spot confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s still on, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the date. The drop-off spot should be the corner near the mailbox, though.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on, and the drop-off spot is by the mailbox corner — just need the exact date, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s happening. I’d just like to confirm the exact time and drop-off spot so the supplies don’t get missed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking for the exact time and drop-off spot, Pia, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal—just let me know as soon as you have it, and I’ll keep an eye on the supplies in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout. I’ll swing by after my errands and see if they still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — that’d be great. If they still need help, I’m sure they’ll appreciate an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll check in after my errands and let you know if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You got it—I’ll bring the gloves and screwdriver, and I’ll swing by to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that’s a big help. The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, so we’ll meet there instead.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’ll head to the community center on Sunday with the gloves and screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — that’s right. The broken fence by the community lot, and we’re meeting at the corner near the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Hana — I’ll let folks know to meet by the mailbox corner. And if anyone can bring work gloves or a screwdriver, that’d really help out at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — thanks, Quinn. I’ll share that folks can bring work gloves or a screwdriver if they have one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the location, so I’m just going by what I’ve heard so far. If you know more, Gus, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I don’t have the exact spot yet either, Nell, but I know we need a hand with patching the cracks and leveling the loose edge by the gate. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — I can help with the cracks and the gate edge once we know where to go. Just keep me posted on the location.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli — we’re mostly looking for tools, spare parts, and a few helping hands for bikes and small appliances. If you want, I can point you to whatever’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Jules. I’ll bring my gloves and stop by when things are set, so I can help sort through whatever’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Eli — gloves will be super helpful. I’ll let you know when everything’s set up and what we need sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great — that’ll be a big help. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the final list, and we can get everything sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know when the list’s final, and I’ll keep things ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear it, and thanks for keeping things ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me—I can coordinate around that. What still needs fixing so I can help keep things moving?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly a few small household fixes—if you can help keep track of who needs what, that’d be a huge help. I’ll jot down the list so I don’t forget it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I can keep track of requests and help match folks up. Once you’ve got the list, send it my way and I’ll help organize it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Mina—if you can drop by, I’ll point you to the urgent fixes first. We’re trying to get the safety stuff handled before anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll focus on the urgent safety fixes first. What time should I come by, and where do you want me to drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Come by this afternoon if you can, and drop things off at my place on Willow Street. I’ll be there to point you straight to the urgent fixes.
